items.headline: Google Parent Alphabet Reports Record Cloud Revenue
items.summary: Google Cloud revenue surged 35% YoY to $12.4B, driven by AI workloads. Alphabet shares rose 3% in after-hours trading.

items.headline: NVIDIA Set to Report Q4 Earnings Amid AI Spending Boom
items.summary: Analysts expect NVIDIA to post record revenue of $38.5B, driven by surging demand for AI training chips from hyperscalers.

items.headline: Bay Area Home Prices Hit New Record in January 2026
items.summary: Median home price in Santa Clara County reached $2.1M, up 8% YoY. Cupertino and Palo Alto led gains driven by tech sector demand.

items.headline: AI Supply Chain Startup NexaFlow Enters Series A Discussions
items.summary: NexaFlow, which uses AI to optimize supply chain logistics, is reportedly in talks with Tier 1 VCs for a $30M Series A round.

items.headline: Meta Revenue Jumps 22% as AI Ad Targeting Boosts Results
items.summary: Meta Platforms reported better-than-expected quarterly results, with AI-driven ad recommendations driving higher engagement and revenue per user.

items.headline: Bitcoin Falls Below $98K as Crypto Market Faces Profit-Taking
items.summary: Major cryptocurrencies declined overnight as traders locked in gains from the recent rally. BTC dropped 3.2% while ETH fell 1.8%.

items.headline: Tesla Robotaxi Approval Expected in Austin by Q2 2026
items.summary: Regulatory sources indicate Tesla may receive its first autonomous ride-hailing permit in Austin, Texas, as early as April.

items.headline: Fed Officials Signal Patience on Rate Cuts Amid Sticky Inflation
items.summary: Federal Reserve governors emphasized data dependency, suggesting rate cuts may be delayed until clear evidence of inflation returning to target.

items.headline: California Expands 529 Plan Tax Benefits for 2026
items.summary: California now allows state income tax deductions up to $10,000 per beneficiary for 529 plan contributions, effective for tax year 2026.

items.headline: Solana DeFi TVL Hits All-Time High of $18B
items.summary: Solana ecosystem DeFi protocols reached record total value locked, with Raydium and Marinade leading the charge.

items.headline: Decentralized Identity Startup VaultEdge Joins Y Combinator W26
items.summary: VaultEdge, building privacy-preserving identity verification for fintech, was accepted into Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch.

items.headline: Private Markets See Record Dry Powder at $4.2 Trillion
items.summary: PE and VC firms are sitting on unprecedented levels of uninvested capital, with AI and climate tech attracting the most interest.

items.headline: Alphabet Q3 2025: Cloud Growth Accelerates to 40%
items.summary: Google Cloud posted $11.2B revenue, beating estimates. AI-driven enterprise adoption cited as primary growth driver.

items.headline: Meta Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Metaverse Losses Narrow
items.summary: Meta reported revenue of $42B, up 19% YoY. Reality Labs losses narrowed to $3.6B as Quest headset sales improved.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady at 4.75% — Signals Two Cuts in 2026
items.summary: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged at its December meeting but projected two 25bp cuts in the first half of 2026, citing moderating inflation.

items.headline: Bitcoin Breaks $90K for First Time, Fueled by ETF Inflows
items.summary: Bitcoin surged past $90,000 as spot ETFs recorded $2.1B in net inflows in November. Institutional allocation continues to increase.

items.headline: Bay Area Housing: Cupertino Median Hits $2.8M in 2025
items.summary: Annual housing data shows Cupertino median home price reached $2.8M, driven by Apple and Google employee demand. Inventory remains at historic lows.

items.headline: NexaFlow Closes $30M Series A Led by Sequoia
items.summary: AI supply chain startup NexaFlow closed its Series A at a $150M valuation. Alex Chen, an early angel investor, holds a $75K seed position now valued at ~$100K.

items.headline: Taiwan Dollar Strengthens as Tech Exports Boom
items.summary: The Taiwan dollar rose to 30.5 per USD, its strongest level since 2022, as semiconductor exports hit record highs. Impact on cross-border transfers noted.

items.headline: S&P 500 Closes 2025 Up 22%, Led by AI and Mega-Cap Tech
items.summary: The S&P 500 finished 2025 with a 22% annual return. Magnificent Seven stocks contributed over half of the gains.
